baseline_models.mechanism: The exception interrupts autonomous future projection: an uttered intention remains a report about a thing whose realization is governed by willing beyond the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Willing attached to a thing supplies contingency and makes the projected act dependent on realization beyond the speaker.
Uttered speech makes the correction explicit and formulable rather than merely inward.

changed_reading.before: Add a pious exception to a statement about the future.
changed_reading.after: Convert future speech from a claim of control into an explicit, revisable dependence on divine willing.

baseline_models.mechanism: Forgetting is not the terminal state but the condition that activates repair: the Lord is re-presented inwardly, mentioned by the tongue, and approached as the one who restores and completes.

activation_trace.role: Re-presenting something after forgetfulness supplies the inward return that reverses the lapse.
Mention on the tongue turns recovered awareness into an audible corrective act.
Loss of a once-present remembrance supplies the failure state from which the loop restarts.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the repeated address to the Lord the governing source of restoration.

changed_reading.before: Remember a missed phrase after forgetting it.
changed_reading.after: Treat the lapse itself as the event that activates a restorative loop of inward recollection, spoken dependence, and renewed orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَسَى أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّي لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَذَا رَشَدًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparative construction does not freeze guidance into one final destination. It asks for movement from the present 'this' toward a nearer position that better hits the sound face of action.

activation_trace.role: Gradual repair and completion make the hoped-for movement a process under the Lord's formation.
Direction, course, and manner supply movement toward a better orientation rather than a bare answer.
Nearness opposed to distance makes improvement comparative and locally reachable.
Hitting the right face of an affair and acting soundly defines the quality by which the nearer course is judged.

changed_reading.before: Ask to be shown the correct destination.
changed_reading.after: Ask for a next position closer than the present one to sound action; guidance is comparative, practical, and iterative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths' earlier petition asks their Lord to prepare right disposition out of their affair. The focus prayer repeats Lord and right disposition after a speech failure, so comparative guidance becomes renewed entry into that prepared-affair pattern.

activation_trace.role: The Lord as repairer and completer grounds the youths' request for an affair to be brought into order.
Preparation and repair for an affair supply the operative transition from danger to a usable course.
The concrete affair or condition gives prepared rightness an object rather than leaving it abstract.
Sound handling that hits the right face of the affair names the result requested by the youths.
The focus repeats sound handling as the measure of the hoped-for nearer course.

structural_cues: 18:10 joins Lord, preparation, affair, and right disposition in one petition; 18:24 rejoins Lord and right disposition after interrupted future speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated Lord/right-disposition pairing and preparation of an affair; I infer that the focus prayer reactivates the earlier petition as a reusable template, while a live alternative is incidental lexical recurrence.

changed_reading.before: Ask for a next position closer to sound action.
changed_reading.after: Re-enter the youths' prayer pattern: entrust the unsettled affair to the Lord so that a sound next course can be prepared out of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance in the surrounding account is increased, then explicitly located in God's guiding and contrasted with deviation. The focus comparative can therefore ask for an added increment or a better replacement route, not merely recovery of a lost instruction.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth make the youths' guidance cumulative rather than static.
Gentle direction to road and truth supplies the earlier gift that is explicitly increased.
The paired guiding and guided forms locate successful direction in God's act and its realized reception.
Deviation from guidance supplies the failed alternative against which a nearer course matters.
Comparative nearness turns the surrounding increase into a local next increment.

structural_cues: 18:13 says their guidance was increased; 18:17 repeats guide/guided and opposes it to deviation; 18:24 asks for what is nearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, divine direction, and the deviation contrast; I infer that comparative nearness can quantify a further increment of guidance, while it may alternatively compare distinct destinations rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: Guidance restores the correct route after a lapse.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be an added increment or replacement route beyond the present one, with successful movement dependent on God's guiding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prepared rightness becomes an ordered survival procedure: secure a useful setting, inspect alternatives, select the pure option, move with subtlety, and prevent detection. The focus request for nearer right disposition thus asks for the next workable action under moral and social risk.

activation_trace.role: Preparation and repair turn requested guidance into conditions fitted for action.
Benefit and usable facility make the prepared outcome practically serviceable.
Directing sight or insight toward alternatives supplies deliberate inspection before choice.
Purity and soundness provide the criterion for selecting food rather than merely finding availability.
Smallness, precision, and concealment make subtle conduct the means of limiting exposure.
Fine awareness and perception define the detection that the procedure is designed to prevent.
Sound disposition in an affair gathers the practical sequence into a model of right action.

structural_cues: 18:19 orders sending, inspecting, selecting, bringing, acting subtly, and avoiding detection as a single decision chain.
The requested preparation of 18:16 becomes an executable sequence in 18:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered imperatives and their branch images; I infer that they concretely realize the requested right disposition, while a live alternative is that these are only local survival tactics with no control over the focus prayer.

changed_reading.before: Right guidance is an abstract correct orientation.
changed_reading.after: Right guidance is the nearest workable, clean, low-exposure action sequence available under present constraints.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cave account places the youths in an open interval while the sun inclines away and passes them by, immediately followed by the guidance statement. Guidance can therefore operate by arranging a viable spatial relation, and 'nearer' can name improved placement rather than only a better proposition.

activation_trace.role: Joining a sheltering place supplies relocation as the first protective move.
Inclining and turning aside makes exposure miss the sheltered bodies by direction.
Cutting across and passing a place to one side supplies the complementary edge of the protective geometry.
The expanded interval between sides provides the viable open space in which protection occurs.
Direction, course, and manner bind the preceding spatial arrangement to the explicit guidance claim.
Nearness permits the focus comparison to be heard as relocation into a more fitting relation.

structural_cues: 18:17 describes right/left passage and an open interval, then immediately labels the scene among God's signs and states the guide/guided relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the spatial geometry and its immediate guidance clause; I infer that arrangement exemplifies a mode of guidance, while the live alternative is that the geometry is only a sign and does not model the focus comparative.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is information about which way to choose.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may arrive as relocation into a viable geometry where exposures pass by; the nearer course can be a better relation to conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Awakening after suspended continuity produces uncertain estimates of elapsed time and an explicit return to the Lord's knowledge. The focus memory loop expands from repairing one missed phrase to recovering orientation after awareness, duration, and confident recall have all broken.

activation_trace.role: Stirring the stationary from repose supplies reactivation after a long interruption.
Disclosure to a knower makes the awakening an epistemic test rather than mere resumed motion.
Repeated staying supplies the duration that the awakened speakers cannot reliably calibrate.
Speech operating as supposition marks their day-or-part-day estimate as provisional before they return knowledge to their Lord.
Loss of remembrance anchors the contextual discontinuity back in the focus command.
Re-presentation after forgetting supplies the recovery operation that follows interrupted continuity.

structural_cues: 18:12 links awakening to determining a stay; 18:19 immediately moves from awakening to a duration question, provisional estimates, and 'your Lord knows best.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suspended awareness, awakening, uncertain duration, and return to the Lord's knowledge; I infer that this amplifies the focus memory loop into reorientation after discontinuity, while the narrower alternative confines forgetting to the omitted exception alone.

changed_reading.before: Repair a momentary verbal lapse by remembering the Lord.
changed_reading.after: After disrupted continuity, restore orientation by returning uncertain memory and duration to the Lord before deciding the next action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated public sayings guess at what is hidden and feed verbal dispute; the next verse projects an act into tomorrow. The focus interrupts both habits with conditional willing, repaired remembrance, and petition, before 18:26 models the bounded utterance 'God knows best.'

activation_trace.role: Sayings circulating among people make repeated count claims proliferate before the focus correction.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible object about which the public sayings overreach.
Sharp verbal disputation shows how uncertain claims become socially self-propelling.
The next day supplies the future horizon that speech prematurely treats as controlled.
The focus imperative replaces proliferating claims with one explicit corrective utterance.
The later imperative supplies the resolved speech form that assigns superior knowledge to God.
Disclosure to the true knower provides the epistemic destination of bounded speech.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from repeated count claims in 18:22, to confident tomorrow-speech in 18:23, to conditional and petitionary speech in 18:24, and finally to 'God knows best' in 18:26.
Both inaccessible past duration and uncontrolled future action are disciplined by imperative forms of 'say.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered speech acts, hidden object, dispute, tomorrow horizon, and final knowledge attribution; I infer that 18:24 is their hinge from assertoric control to bounded petition, while the live alternative treats the adjacent commands as unrelated topic-specific rules.

changed_reading.before: Add an exception to one future claim.
changed_reading.after: Replace claim-heavy speech with a bounded sequence: condition action, repair lapse, petition for nearer rightness, and return inaccessible knowledge to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's split mapping from focus q-w-l to Furuq q-l-l rather than normal morphology. It remains locally anchored through explicit q-l-l and proliferating q-w-l in 18:22; downstream prose should render it only as an economy-of-speech resonance, never as the lexical translation of قُلْ.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of littleness compresses the commanded speech into a minimal corrective utterance.
Circulating sayings supply the proliferating speech against which the focus utterance becomes small and bounded.
Explicit fewness activates the q-l-l branch immediately before the focus imperative.

changed_reading.before: The command simply requires saying the corrective formula.
changed_reading.after: After proliferating public claims, the mandated response is deliberately little: a short, bounded utterance that reduces rather than multiplies assertion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hope of milk returning after cessation is a material branch image, not the ordinary lexical gloss of عَسَى. It remains useful because the focus joins hope to forgotten continuity and the context supplies awakening after suspension; downstream prose should qualify it as an interruption-return analogy only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَى أَن يَهْدِيَنِ

activation_trace.role: Hope for milk's return after cessation supplies a material image of renewed availability following interruption.
Loss of remembrance provides the focus interruption from which hoped-for guidance may resume.
Stirring sleepers from repose externalizes resumption after a prolonged suspension.

changed_reading.before: Perhaps merely softens certainty about receiving guidance.
changed_reading.after: Hope holds open renewed guidance after memory or awareness has gone offline; interruption need not be final.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes a hinge from speculative and future-controlling speech to bounded dependence and petition.
Right disposition becomes a prepared, risk-sensitive sequence of next actions rather than an abstract answer.
Comparative nearness makes guidance incremental and permits a spatial mode in which conditions are providentially rearranged.
Remembering after forgetting expands into recovery of orientation after interrupted awareness and uncertain duration.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus prayer echo the youths' earlier request for prepared right disposition, then showed that disposition as practical discretion and protected placement. It also sustained two contained branch activations likely to be lost in conservative synthesis: minimal speech through q-w-l/q-l-l and renewed availability through the return-after-cessation image of ع س ي.
remaining_uncertainties: The deictic scope of 'this' may be the projected act, the current route, the present epistemic position, or a nearby narrative claim.
The command to remember after forgetting may target the omitted exception narrowly or any broader break in orientation.
The providential-geometry reading is strongly sequenced but remains analogical rather than a necessary lexical reading of guidance.
